brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the Qalandia Institute for Vocational Training for Refugees in Qalandia camp north of Jerusalem on Monday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The Jerusalem Governorate confirmed the incursion in a statement, saying forces stormed the facility and deployed throughout its grounds. The institute serves refugee populations in the camp.

The raid represents another military operation at the UN-affiliated vocational center. The stated objective of the operation and whether any arrests were made remain unclear. No immediate reports detailed property damage or other specifics from the dawn incursion into the refugee camp's educational facility.
